description.en: 给 AI agent 加一张脸的实时数字人 API，官方称平均响应 180ms、支持 70+ 语言，最新模型 Cara-4 主打微表情与口型同步。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Anam (https://anam.ai/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏纯白，导航只留 Developers / Pricing / Resources 和一颗 Sign in 药丸。上面一条浅橙提示带写 Meet our most expressive model: Cara-4，主标题 Create interactive avatars for your business（前两行黑、第三行灰），下面 Sign up 黑按钮与 Get a demo 浅灰按钮。主视觉是四张并排的人像卡，从左到右是一位白发男性、一位卷发女性、一位花白胡须男性和一位黑发女性，都穿同款米白色拉链高领，衣服上印着 Anam 字样。往下是对话示例 Talk with Sophie，正文写 By upgrading your agent with a face, you can increase engagement by +44%。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
